title: Booked all week
setting: Monday morning at the office. Mai comes in to find her manager, Tanaka-san, already at his desk. He wants to take the team out to eat one evening this week.

speakers.name: Mai
speakers.voice: female, late 20s, warm, a little shy

speakers.name: Tanaka-san
speakers.voice: male, 40s, calm and kind, polite office speech

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: ohayou gozaimasu. tanaka-san, kyou mo asa hayai desu ne.
lines.ja: おはようございます。田中さん、今日も朝早いですね。
lines.kana: おはようございます。たなかさん、きょうもあさはやいですね。
lines.english: Good morning, Tanaka-san. You're in early again today.

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: ohayou gozaimasu. kimura-san, konshuu, minna de gohan ni ikimasen ka? kyou no yoru wa dou desu ka?
lines.ja: おはようございます。木村さん、今週、みんなでごはんに行きませんか？今日の夜はどうですか？
lines.kana: おはようございます。きむらさん、こんしゅう、みんなでごはんにいきませんか？きょうのよるはどうですか？
lines.english: Morning. Kimura-san, how about we all go out to eat this week? How's tonight?

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: ii desu ne! a, demo kyou wa chotto youji ga atte...
lines.ja: いいですね！あ、でも今日はちょっと用事があって…
lines.kana: いいですね！あ、でもきょうはちょっとようじがあって…
lines.english: Sounds great! Oh, but I've got something on today, so...

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: sou desu ka. jaa, ashita wa dou desu ka?
lines.ja: そうですか。じゃあ、明日はどうですか？
lines.kana: そうですか。じゃあ、あしたはどうですか？
lines.english: I see. Then how about tomorrow?

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: ashita wa... suiyoubi no asa ga hayai n desu. rokuji no densha ni noru node.
lines.ja: 明日は…水曜日の朝が早いんです。六時の電車に乗るので。
lines.kana: あしたは…すいようびのあさがはやいんです。ろくじのでんしゃにのるので。
lines.english: Tomorrow's... I've got an early start on Wednesday. I'm catching the six o'clock train.

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: rokuji desu ka! jaa, suiyoubi ka mokuyoubi wa?
lines.ja: 六時ですか！じゃあ、水曜日か木曜日は？
lines.kana: ろくじですか！じゃあ、すいようびかもくようびは？

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: sumimasen, suiyoubi mo mokuyoubi mo, mou yotei ga haitte iru n desu.
lines.ja: すみません、水曜日も木曜日も、もう予定が入っているんです。
lines.kana: すみません、すいようびももくようびも、もうよていがはいっているんです。
lines.english: Sorry, Wednesday and Thursday are both booked already.

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: jaa, kin'youbi wa? tsugi no hi wa doyoubi desu kara, asa mo yukkuri dekimasu yo.
lines.ja: じゃあ、金曜日は？次の日は土曜日ですから、朝もゆっくりできますよ。
lines.kana: じゃあ、きんようびは？つぎのひはどようびですから、あさもゆっくりできますよ。
lines.english: Friday, then? The next day's Saturday, so you can take it easy in the morning.

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: kin'youbi wa... sumimasen, sen'yaku ga atte...
lines.ja: 金曜日は…すみません、先約があって…
lines.kana: きんようびは…すみません、せんやくがあって…
lines.english: Friday... I'm sorry, I already have plans that day...

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: kimura-san... watashi to gohan, iya na n desu ka?
lines.ja: 木村さん…私とごはん、嫌なんですか？
lines.kana: きむらさん…わたしとごはん、いやなんですか？
lines.english: Kimura-san... do you just not want to eat with me?

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: chigaimasu yo! kyou no youji mo, kin'youbi no sen'yaku mo, honto ni aru n desu!
lines.ja: 違いますよ！今日の用事も、金曜日の先約も、ほんとにあるんです！
lines.kana: ちがいますよ！きょうのようじも、きんようびのせんやくも、ほんとにあるんです！
lines.english: No, that's not it! Today's thing and Friday's plans are both real!

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: sumimasen, joudan desu yo. sen'yaku ga aru nara, sotchi ga saki desu ne.
lines.ja: すみません、冗談ですよ。先約があるなら、そっちが先ですね。
lines.kana: すみません、じょうだんですよ。せんやくがあるなら、そっちがさきですね。
lines.english: Sorry, I'm only joking. If you made plans first, those come first.

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: kin'youbi wa, yuki-san to karaoke ni iku n desu. tanaka-san mo issho ni dou desu ka?
lines.ja: 金曜日は、ユキさんとカラオケに行くんです。田中さんも一緒にどうですか？
lines.kana: きんようびは、ゆきさんとからおけにいくんです。たなかさんもいっしょにどうですか？
lines.english: On Friday, Yuki-san and I are going to karaoke. Why don't you come too, Tanaka-san?

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: e, ii n desu ka? kin'youbi no yoru wa, mada yotei wa haitte imasen yo.
lines.ja: え、いいんですか？金曜日の夜は、まだ予定は入っていませんよ。
lines.kana: え、いいんですか？きんようびのよるは、まだよていははいっていませんよ。
lines.english: Oh, are you sure? Nothing's booked for my Friday night yet.

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: yokatta! jaa, yuki-san ni renraku shimasu ne.
lines.ja: よかった！じゃあ、ユキさんに連絡しますね。
lines.kana: よかった！じゃあ、ゆきさんにれんらくしますね。
lines.english: Great! I'll let Yuki-san know, then.

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: onegai shimasu. a, demo watashi wa ichijikan dake ni shimasu ne. doyoubi no asa ga hayai node.
lines.ja: お願いします。あ、でも私は一時間だけにしますね。土曜日の朝が早いので。
lines.kana: おねがいします。あ、でもわたしはいちじかんだけにしますね。どようびのあさがはやいので。
lines.english: Please do. Oh, but I'll only stay an hour. I've got an early start on Saturday.

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: e? tsugi no hi wa doyoubi da kara, asa mo yukkuri dekiru tte...
lines.ja: え？次の日は土曜日だから、朝もゆっくりできるって…
lines.kana: え？つぎのひはどようびだから、あさもゆっくりできるって…
lines.english: What? But you said the next day's Saturday, so we could take it easy in the morning...

lines.speaker: tanaka
lines.romaji: sore wa kimura-san no hanashi desu yo. watashi wa mainichi asa ga hayai n desu.
lines.ja: それは木村さんの話ですよ。私は毎日朝が早いんです。
lines.kana: それはきむらさんのはなしですよ。わたしはまいにちあさがはやいんです。
lines.english: That was about you. Me, I'm up early every day.

choices.english: Mai doesn't really want to eat with Tanaka-san, so she makes up an excuse for every day he suggests.
Mai is free on Friday, but Tanaka-san has an early start on Saturday, so they put the dinner off.
Mai can't make any evening Tanaka-san suggests, so she invites him along to her Friday karaoke with Yuki.

questions.explanation: Line 2: Tanaka-san wants everyone to go out to eat this week. Mai can't do tonight (line 3: youji ga atte...), tomorrow (line 5: she has an early start on Wednesday), Wednesday or Thursday (line 7: already booked) or Friday (line 9: sen'yaku ga atte...). Line 13: her Friday plan is karaoke with Yuki, and she asks Tanaka-san to come too. In line 14 he says his Friday night is free. A is wrong: Tanaka-san only jokes that she doesn't want to eat with him (line 10), he says it was a joke (line 12), and Mai says her reasons are all real (line 11). B is wrong: Friday is the day Mai already has plans (line 9), and Tanaka-san's early Saturday only means he'll stay an hour at the karaoke (line 16).

questions.english: Yuki asks you, "kyou, shigoto owattara, gohan ikanai?" (Want to grab dinner after work today?) You can't make it. Turn her down the usual vague way, without saying what you're doing.
questions.ja: 今日、仕事終わったら、ごはん行かない？
questions.kana: きょう、しごとおわったら、ごはんいかない？
questions.answer: Give the vague reason with youji and aru, and let it trail off: gomen, kyou wa chotto youji ga atte...

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen, kyou wa chotto youji ga atte...
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん、今日はちょっと用事があって…
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, I've got something on today, so...

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen! kyou wa youji ga aru n da. mata kondo ne.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん！今日は用事があるんだ。また今度ね。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry! I've got something to do today. Next time, okay?

questions.explanation: Having something to do takes aru: Mai turns down tonight with kyou wa chotto youji ga atte... (line 3), and later insists kyou no youji mo... honto ni aru n desu (line 11). Don't say youji o motte iru: English 'have' points to motsu, but errands and things on are aru. Stopping after atte... is the polite part: the 'so I can't' is left unsaid, and nobody asks what the youji is. If something has just come up, the verb is dekiru: kyuu ni youji ga dekichatte, not okichatte. Yuki is a friend, so both answers are casual; with Tanaka-san it would be youji ga aru n desu.

questions.english: When Tanaka-san suggests tomorrow evening, why is that no good for Mai?
questions.ja: 木村さんは、明日の夜、どうしてだめなんですか？
questions.kana: きむらさんは、あしたのよる、どうしてだめなんですか？
questions.romaji: kimura-san wa, ashita no yoru, doushite dame na n desu ka?

choices.english: She has to be up early on Wednesday to catch a six o'clock train.
She has to leave work early tomorrow to catch a six o'clock train.
She gets in early every day, like Tanaka-san, so she's too tired in the evenings.

questions.explanation: Line 5: suiyoubi no asa ga hayai n desu. asa ga hayai makes the morning the subject: Wednesday's morning starts early, because she's catching the six o'clock train (rokuji no densha ni noru node). A late dinner on Tuesday night would clash with that. B is wrong: the train is at six in the morning (asa), not six in the evening, and she says nothing about leaving work early. C mixes it up with line 1, where Mai says kyou mo asa hayai desu ne to Tanaka-san: he's the one who is in early every day (line 18: watashi wa mainichi asa ga hayai n desu).

questions.english: When Tanaka-san asks about Wednesday or Thursday, what does Mai say?
questions.ja: 木村さんは何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: きむらさんはなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: kimura-san wa nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: I already have plans on both Wednesday and Thursday (with motsu, 'hold').
choices.romaji: suiyoubi mo mokuyoubi mo, mou yotei o motte iru n desu.

choices.english: Wednesday and Thursday are both booked already.
choices.romaji: suiyoubi mo mokuyoubi mo, mou yotei ga haitte iru n desu.

choices.english: Things came up on both Wednesday and Thursday (with okiru, 'happen').
choices.romaji: suiyoubi mo mokuyoubi mo, yotei ga okite shimatta n desu.

questions.explanation: Line 7: mou yotei ga haitte iru n desu. Plans go into a day (hairu), and haitte iru says the day is already taken. Tanaka-san uses the same verb in line 14 when he finds his Friday free (mada yotei wa haitte imasen). A is 'have plans' word for word: motsu is holding or carrying something, and plans never take motsu. Plain 'I have plans' is yotei ga aru. C uses okiru for 'come up', but okiru is for things that happen, like an accident or an earthquake, so it sounds as if something went wrong. A plan that comes up suddenly is kyuu ni yotei ga haitta.

questions.english: Satou-san, your elderly neighbour, invites you: "nichiyoubi, uchi de ocha demo dou desu ka?" (Would you like to come over for tea on Sunday?) You've already promised Sunday to someone else. Turn him down politely.
questions.ja: 日曜日、うちでお茶でもどうですか？
questions.kana: にちようび、うちでおちゃでもどうですか？
questions.romaji: nichiyoubi, uchi de ocha demo dou desu ka?
questions.answer: Turn it down with sen'yaku ga aru and let it trail off: sumimasen, nichiyoubi wa sen'yaku ga atte...

modelAnswers.romaji: sumimasen, nichiyoubi wa sen'yaku ga atte...
modelAnswers.ja: すみません、日曜日は先約があって…
modelAnswers.english: I'm sorry, I already have plans on Sunday...

modelAnswers.romaji: arigatou gozaimasu. demo, sono hi wa sen'yaku ga aru n desu. mata kondo, onegai shimasu.
modelAnswers.ja: ありがとうございます。でも、その日は先約があるんです。また今度、お願いします。
modelAnswers.english: Thank you. But I already have plans that day. Another time, please.

questions.explanation: sen'yaku is a plan made earlier, usually with someone else, and like youji it takes aru. Mai uses it to turn down her manager in line 9 (kin'youbi wa... sumimasen, sen'yaku ga atte...), and Tanaka-san accepts it at once in line 12 (sen'yaku ga aru nara, sotchi ga saki desu ne: plans made first come first). That's why it suits an older neighbour: yotei ga aru also works but is vaguer, while sen'yaku tells him the day was promised first. Let it trail after atte..., or soften it with ...n desu; a flat ...kara sounds like an excuse. Never sen'yaku o motte imasu.

newWords.english: day (tsugi no hi = the next day)
